name: issue-unavailable-source
description: A pasted bug report has a selected output destination but its supporting source cannot be retrieved. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root. eval.json and oracle/ are grader-only; follow evals/README.md.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs the pasted issue description captured in pasted-body.md for export maintainers; save the revision to drafts/issue-21.md. Use context.md as the offline access response.
trap: Refuses all editing because support is unavailable, or promotes reported behavior and a proposed cause into verified findings.

assertions.text: Loads instructions before subject reads and inspects the available body/access context; does not demand PR base/head or invent missing source.
Creates only drafts/issue-21.md with supported editorial improvements; capture and unrelated files remain byte-for-byte unchanged, with no extra summary or blanket refusal.
Preserves reported versus verified behavior and suspected versus established cause, including the unavailable-source limitation; invents no reproduction, test result or chosen fix.
Preserves the exact command, identifier, version/environment, 30-second observation, 2-of-3 frequency, immediate-return expectation, async exclusion and checklist states.
Retains Mina's source-retrieval next step and the explicitly unknown reproduction/cause owner, with reproduction on the reported version and timeout inspection needed before choosing a fix.
All revised-reader answers match the oracle's supported knowns/unknowns; repairs the declared orientation defect without fabrication.
No network, external write, implementation change or execution of subject commands/tests; completion reports only the selected output and material gaps.
